description: This Kotlin source file defines a CalendarHandler class along with related data classes and an internal data source implementation for managing calendar events on Android devices. It handles permissions, fetching, and adding calendar events, parsing parameters from JSON, and constructing responses.

classes.name: CalendarEventsRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to fetch calendar events within a specified time range and limit.

classes.name: CalendarAddRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to add a new calendar event with parameters like title, start/end times, location, etc.

classes.name: CalendarEventRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event's data, including identifier, title, ISO start/end times, location, and calendar name.

classes.name: CalendarDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking permissions, retrieving events, and adding events to a data source.

classes.name: SystemCalendarDataSource
classes.description: Internal object implementing CalendarDataSource for interacting with Android's calendar provider.

classes.name: CalendarHandler
classes.description: Main class coordinating calendar event query and insertion, processing JSON requests and responses, managing permissions, and interfacing with data source.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read the calendar.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to write to the calendar.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Fetches calendar events based on a request, returns a list of CalendarEventRecord.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new calendar event based on the provided request, returns the created CalendarEventRecord.

methods.name: handleCalendarEvents
methods.description: Handles incoming request to fetch calendar events, returns a GatewaySession.InvokeResult with JSON data.

methods.name: handleCalendarAdd
methods.description: Handles request to add a new calendar event, returns a GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: parseEventsRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input for calendar event query parameters, returns a CalendarEventsRequest.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input for calendar add event parameters, returns a CalendarAddRequest.

methods.name: parseISO
methods.description: Parses an ISO date string into an Instant.

methods.name: eventJson
methods.description: Converts a CalendarEventRecord into a JSON object for output.
